mapper.select: SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `groups` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, CONCAT(users.first_name, ' ', users.last_name) as name FROM `users` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND user_type != 3 AND (users.first_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR users.last_name LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT companies.`id` AS id, companies.`name` AS name, currency_center_id AS currencyId, currency_centers.name AS currencyName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol FROM `companies` INNER JOIN currency_centers ON companies.currency_center_id = currency_centers.id WHERE companies.`is_active` = 1 AND companies.id IN (SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId})
AND `name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%')
ORDER BY `id` ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` AS id, IFNULL(chart_accounts.parent_id, 0) AS parentId, CONCAT(chart_accounts.account_codes, ' - ', chart_accounts.account_description) AS name FROM `chart_accounts` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND id IN ( SELECT chart_account_id FROM chart_account_companies WHERE company_id IN ( SELECT company_id FROM user_companies WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) )
AND `name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
AND chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id IN (6,8)
AND chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id IN (8) AND chart_accounts.parent_id IN (51)
AND chart_accounts.chart_account_type_id IN
#{typeId}
ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, user_id as userId, `name` as nameEn, name_kh AS nameKh, code AS code FROM `employees` WHERE `is_active` = 1 AND employees.id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM employee_companies)
AND (`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%") OR `name_kh` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%"))
AND is_show_in_sales = 1
AND id IN (SELECT employee_id FROM employee_egroups WHERE egroup_id = #{filter.employeeGroupId})
ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT location_groups.`id` AS id, location_groups.`name` AS name FROM `location_groups` INNER JOIN `user_location_groups` ON `location_groups`.`id` = `user_location_groups`.`location_group_id`
user_location_groups.user_id = #{userId}
AND `is_active` = 1
AND `is_active` = 8
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `locations` WHERE `location_group_id` = location_groups.`id` AND `is_for_sale` = 0)
AND (`name` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{filter.searchText}, '%'))
ORDER BY `id` ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` AS id, `name` AS name FROM price_types WHERE `is_active` = 1
AND (`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%"))
AND id IN (SELECT price_type_id FROM price_type_companies WHERE company_id = #{filter.companyId})
AND id IN (SELECT price_type_id FROM cgroup_price_types WHERE cgroup_id IN (SELECT cgroup_id FROM customer_cgroups WHERE customer_id = #{filter.organizationId}))
ORDER BY ordering ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, `name` as name FROM `countries`
`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
ORDER BY id ASC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT currency_centers.`id` as id, currency_centers.`name` as name,
company_currencies.exchange_rate_id as exchangeRateId, company_currencies.rate_to_sell as rateToSell, company_currencies.rate_to_purchase as rateToPurchase,
currency_centers.`symbol` as symbol FROM `currency_centers`
LEFT JOIN vendor_currencies ON currency_centers.id = vendor_currencies.currency_center_id LEFT JOIN company_currencies ON company_currencies.currency_center_id = currency_centers.id AND company_currencies.is_active = 1
WHERE currency_centers.`is_active` = 1
AND (`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%"))
AND vendor_currencies.vendor_id = #{filter.vendorId}
AND company_currencies.currency_center_id = #{filter.currencyCenterId}
AND vendor_currencies.is_active = 1
GROUP BY currency_centers.id
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT `id` as id, IFNULL((SELECT id FROM `uom_conversions` WHERE `from_uom_id` = uoms.id AND `is_small_uom` = 1 AND `is_active` = 1 LIMIT 1), 0) AS smallUomId, `name` as name FROM `uoms` WHERE `is_active` = 1
AND (`name` LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%"))
AND id NOT IN (SELECT from_uom_id FROM uom_conversions WHERE is_active = 1) AND id NOT IN (SELECT to_uom_id FROM uom_conversions WHERE is_active = 1)
AND id NOT IN (SELECT from_uom_id FROM uom_conversions WHERE is_active = 1)
ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT orders.id AS id, customers.id AS customerId, orders.customer_contact_id AS customerContactId, orders.customer_po_number AS customerPoNumber, orders.discount AS discount, orders.discount_percent AS discountPercent, orders.price_type_id AS priceTypeId, orders.delivery_date AS deliveryDate, orders.order_code AS orderCode, orders.order_date AS orderDate, customers.name AS customerName, orders.is_wso AS isWso, (orders.total_amount - orders.discount + orders.total_vat) AS netAmount, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol FROM orders INNER JOIN customers ON customers.id = orders.customer_id INNER JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = orders.currency_center_id WHERE
orders.status IN (1,2,3) AND orders.is_approve = 1 AND orders.is_close = 1 AND orders.type = 1 AND orders.id IN (SELECT so.order_id FROM sales_orders AS so WHERE so.status > 0 AND so.delivery_id IS NULL)
orders.status = 1 AND orders.is_approve = 1 AND orders.is_close = 0 AND orders.remark = 0
ORDER BY
${filter.orderBy}
orders.id DESC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

( SELECT 1 AS `type`, order_details.id AS id, order_details.order_id AS orderId, order_details.product_id AS itemId, products.barcode AS sku, products.code AS upc, products.name AS itemName, order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, (products.small_val_uom / IFNULL(order_details.conversion,1)) AS conversion, (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = products.id) AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM pgroups WHERE id = (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = products.id LIMIT 1)) AS categoryName, order_details.order_id AS orderId, order_details.qty AS qty, products.unit_cost AS unitPrice, products.unit_cost * IFNULL(order_details.qty,0) AS totalPrice FROM order_details LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = order_details.qty_uom_id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = order_details.product_id WHERE order_details.order_id = #{orderId} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, order_services.id AS id, order_services.order_id AS orderId, order_services.service_id AS itemId, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, services.name AS itemName, services.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, order_services.conversion AS conversion, services.section_id AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM sections WHERE id = services.section_id) AS categoryName, order_services.order_id AS orderId, order_services.qty AS qty, services.unit_price AS unitPrice, services.unit_price * IFNULL(order_services.qty,0) AS totalPrice FROM order_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = order_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = services.uom_id WHERE order_services.order_id = #{orderId} ) UNION ( SELECT 3 AS `type`, order_services.id AS id, order_services.order_id AS orderId, order_services.service_id AS itemId, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, services.name AS itemName, services.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, order_services.conversion AS conversion, services.section_id AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM sections WHERE id = services.section_id) AS categoryName, order_services.order_id AS orderId, order_services.qty AS qty, services.unit_price AS unitPrice, services.unit_price * IFNULL(order_services.qty,0) AS totalPrice FROM order_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = order_services.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = services.uom_id WHERE order_services.order_id = #{orderId} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC

SELECT COUNT(purchase_orders.id) AS id FROM purchase_orders LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_orders.vendor_id LEFT JOIN locations ON locations.id = purchase_orders.location_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = purchase_orders.currency_center_id WHERE purchase_orders.status > 0
AND purchase_orders.po_code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
AND purchase_orders.status = 3 AND purchase_orders.vendor_id = #{filter.vendorId} AND (purchase_orders.balance > 0 AND purchase_orders.balance IS NOT NULL)

SELECT purchase_orders.id AS id, purchase_orders.order_date AS orderDate, purchase_orders.po_code AS poCode, vendors.id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, purchase_orders.balance AS balance, purchase_orders.location_id AS locationId, locations.name AS locationName, purchase_orders.total_amount AS totalAmount, purchase_orders.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, exchange_rates.rate_to_purchase AS rateToPurchase, purchase_orders.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol, purchase_orders.status AS status FROM purchase_orders LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_orders.vendor_id LEFT JOIN locations ON locations.id = purchase_orders.location_id LEFT JOIN exchange_rates ON exchange_rates.id = purchase_orders.exchange_rate_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = purchase_orders.currency_center_id WHERE purchase_orders.status > 0
AND purchase_orders.po_code LIKE CONCAT("%", #{filter.searchText}, "%")
AND purchase_orders.pv_request_id IS NULL AND purchase_orders.payment_term_id IN (SELECT id FROM payment_terms WHERE payment_type_id = 2)
AND purchase_orders.id NOT IN (SELECT purchase_order_id FROM landed_cost_purchase_orders) AND purchase_orders.is_approve = 1
AND purchase_orders.status = 3 AND purchase_orders.vendor_id = #{filter.vendorId} AND (purchase_orders.balance > 0 AND purchase_orders.balance IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY
${filter.orderBy}
purchase_orders.id DESC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

(SELECT 1 AS `type`, purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id AS purchaseBillId, purchase_order_details.id AS purchaseBillDetailId, purchase_order_details.product_id AS itemId, products.barcode AS sku, products.code AS upc, products.name AS itemName, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, (products.small_val_uom / IFNULL(purchase_order_details.conversion,1)) AS conversion, purchase_orders.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, purchase_order_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = products.id LIMIT 1) AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM pgroups WHERE id = (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = products.id LIMIT 1)) AS categoryName, (purchase_order_details.qty + purchase_order_details.qty_free) AS qty, purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, purchase_order_details.date_expired AS expiredDate, purchase_order_details.unit_cost AS unitPrice, purchase_order_details.total_cost AS totalPrice, purchase_order_details.note AS note FROM purchase_order_details LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_orders.vendor_id LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = purchase_order_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId})
UNION ALL
(SELECT 2 AS `type`, prs.purchase_order_id AS purchaseBillId, prs.id AS purchaseBillDetailId, prs.service_id AS itemId, s.sku AS sku, s.sku AS upc, s.name AS itemName, NULL AS isExpiredDate, 1 AS conversion, purchase_orders.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, prs.discount_amount AS discountAmount, s.section_id AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM sections WHERE id = s.section_id) AS categoryName, (prs.qty+prs.qty_free) AS qty, s.uom_id AS uomId, u.name AS uomName, NULL AS expiredDate, prs.unit_cost AS unitPrice, prs.total_cost AS totalPrice, prs.note AS note FROM purchase_order_services prs LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = prs.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_orders.vendor_id LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = prs.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms u ON u.id = s.uom_id WHERE prs.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId})
UNION ALL
(SELECT 3 AS `type`, purchase_order_miscs.purchase_order_id AS purchaseBillId, NULL AS purchaseBillDetailId, purchase_order_miscs.id AS itemId, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, purchase_order_miscs.description AS itemName, NULL AS isExpiredDate, 1 AS conversion, purchase_orders.vendor_id AS vendorId, vendors.name AS vendorName, purchase_order_miscs.discount_amount AS discountAmount, NULL AS categoryId, NULL AS categoryName, (purchase_order_miscs.qty+purchase_order_miscs.qty_free) AS qty, purchase_order_miscs.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, NULL AS expiredDate, purchase_order_miscs.unit_cost AS unitPrice, purchase_order_miscs.total_cost AS totalPrice, purchase_order_miscs.note AS note FROM purchase_order_miscs LEFT JOIN purchase_orders ON purchase_orders.id = purchase_order_miscs.purchase_order_id LEFT JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_orders.vendor_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_miscs.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_order_miscs.purchase_order_id = #{purchaseOrderId})

SELECT purchase_requests.id AS id, purchase_requests.final_place_of_delivery_id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, purchase_requests.vendor_id AS vendorId, (SELECT CASE WHEN purchase_receive_results.status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE purchase_receive_results.purchase_request_id = purchase_requests.id AND purchase_receive_results.status = 1 LIMIT 1) AS hasGoodReceiptNote, purchase_requests.payment_id AS paymentTermId, purchase_requests.pv_request_id AS pvRequestId, IFNULL(purchase_requests.total_deposit,0) AS totalDeposit, purchase_requests.exchange_rate_id AS exchangeRateId, IFNULL(exchange_rates.rate_to_purchase,0) AS rateToPurchase, purchase_requests.pr_code AS poCode, purchase_requests.order_date AS orderDate, CONCAT_WS(" - ",vendors.vendor_code,vendors.name) AS vendorName, purchase_requests.total_amount AS totalAmount, purchase_requests.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.name AS currencyName, currency_centers.symbol AS currencySymbol FROM `purchase_requests` INNER JOIN vendors ON vendors.id = purchase_requests.vendor_id INNER JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = purchase_requests.final_place_of_delivery_id LEFT JOIN exchange_rates ON exchange_rates.id = purchase_requests.exchange_rate_id LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = purchase_requests.currency_center_id WHERE purchase_requests.is_close = 0 AND purchase_requests.status IN (1,2)
AND purchase_requests.id NOT IN (SELECT IFNULL(order_id,0) FROM pv_request_orders WHERE status = 2 AND pv_request_orders.pv_request_id IN (SELECT id FROM pv_requests WHERE status > 0)) AND purchase_requests.payment_id NOT IN (SELECT id FROM payment_terms WHERE payment_type_id = 2)
AND purchase_requests.id NOT IN (SELECT IFNULL(purchase_request_id,0) FROM purchase_orders WHERE status > 0)
ORDER BY
${filter.orderBy}
purchase_requests.id DESC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}
SELECT payment_type_id FROM payment_terms WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT pv_requests.id AS id, pv_requests.status AS status FROM `pv_requests` INNER JOIN purchase_requests ON pv_requests.id = purchase_requests.pv_request_id WHERE purchase_requests.id = #{id}

SELECT exchange_rates.id AS exchangeRateId, exchange_rates.currency_center_id AS currencyCenterId, currency_centers.symbol AS symbol, currency_centers.name AS name, exchange_rates.rate_to_sell AS rateToSell, exchange_rates.rate_to_purchase AS rateToPurchase FROM exchange_rates LEFT JOIN currency_centers ON currency_centers.id = exchange_rates.currency_center_id WHERE exchange_rates.is_active = 1 AND currency_centers.is_active = 1 AND exchange_rates.id = (SELECT exchange_rate_id FROM pv_requests WHERE id = #{id}) AND exchange_rates.currency_center_id = (SELECT currency_center_id FROM pv_requests WHERE id = #{id})

(SELECT 1 AS `type`, prd.purchase_request_id AS purchaseOrderId, prd.id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, prd.product_id AS itemId, p.code AS sku, p.barcode AS upc, p.name AS itemName, p.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, (SELECT date_expired FROM purchase_receives WHERE purchase_receive_result_id IN (SELECT id FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE purchase_request_id = prd.purchase_request_id) LIMIT 1) AS expiredDate, (p.small_val_uom / IFNULL(prd.conversion,1)) AS conversion, (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = p.id LIMIT 1) AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM pgroups WHERE id = (SELECT pgroup_id FROM product_pgroups WHERE product_id = p.id LIMIT 1)) AS categoryName, prd.qty AS qty, prd.qty_uom_id AS uomId, u.name AS uomName, prd.unit_cost AS unitPrice, prd.total_cost AS totalPrice, prd.note AS note FROM purchase_request_details prd LEFT JOIN products p ON p.id = prd.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms u ON u.id = prd.qty_uom_id WHERE prd.purchase_request_id = #{purchaseOrderId})
UNION ALL
(SELECT 2 AS `type`, prs.purchase_request_id AS purchaseOrderId, prs.id AS purchaseOrderDetailId, prs.service_id AS itemId, s.sku AS sku, s.sku AS upc, s.name AS itemName, NULL AS isExpiredDate, NULL AS expiredDate, 1 AS conversion, s.section_id AS categoryId, (SELECT name FROM sections WHERE id = s.section_id LIMIT 1) AS categoryName, prs.qty AS qty, s.uom_id AS uomId, u.name AS uomName, prs.unit_cost AS unitPrice, prs.total_cost AS totalPrice, prs.note AS note FROM purchase_request_services prs LEFT JOIN services s ON s.id = prs.service_id LEFT JOIN uoms u ON u.id = s.uom_id WHERE prs.purchase_request_id = #{purchaseOrderId})

SELECT SUM(qty * IFNULL(conversion, 1)) AS qty FROM purchase_receives WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND purchase_receive_result_id IN (SELECT id FROM purchase_receive_results WHERE purchase_request_id = #{purchaseOrderId} AND status > 0)

SELECT product_with_skus.id as skuId, product_with_skus.sku as skuName, products.id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.default_cost AS lastCost FROM `product_with_skus` LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = product_with_skus.product_id WHERE products.is_active = 1 ORDER BY product_with_skus.id DESC
LIMIT #{filter.page}, #{filter.rowsPerPage}

SELECT module_code_companies.company_id AS id, companies.name AS name, COALESCE(module_code_companies.adj_code, '') AS adjCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.request_code, '') AS requestCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.to_code, '') AS toCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.tr_code, '') AS trCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.pos_code, '') AS posCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.pos_rep_code, '') AS posRepCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.quote_code, '') AS quoteCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.so_code, '') AS soCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.inv_code, '') AS invCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.inv_rep_code, '') AS invRepCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.dn_code, '') AS dnCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.receive_pay_code, '') AS receivePayCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.cm_code, '') AS cmCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.cm_rep_code, '') AS cmRepCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.pr_code, '') AS prCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.po_code, '') AS poCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.pb_code, '') AS pbCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.pb_rep_code, '') AS pbRepCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.br_code, '') AS brCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.br_rep_code, '') AS brRepCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.pay_bill_code, '') AS payBillCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.landed_cost_code, '') AS landedCostCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.landed_cost_receipt_code, '') AS landedCostReceiptCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.bom_code, '') AS bomCode, COALESCE(module_code_companies.boq_code, '') AS boqCode FROM `module_code_companies` LEFT JOIN companies ON companies.id = module_code_companies.company_id WHERE company_id = #{filter.companyId} ORDER BY module_code_companies.id ASC
